definitions.explanation: an organization of parents and teachers at a school that works together on educational and school-related activities

examples.japanese: PTA⟦{会長|かいちょう}→会長：11610_kaichou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれた→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
PTA⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{負担|ふたん}→負担：09752_futan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。
examples.english: PTA activities are a big burden.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧、PTA⟦{総会|そうかい}→総会：13855_soukai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a PTA general meeting next week.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- PTA⟦{会長|かいちょう}→会長：11610_kaichou⟧ - PTA president
- PTA⟦{副会長|ふくかいちょう}→副会長：20469_fukukaichou⟧ - PTA vice president
- PTA⟦{役員|やくいん}→役員：11329_yakuin⟧ - PTA officer/board member
- PTA⟦{会費|かいひ}→会費：08469_kaihi⟧ - PTA membership fees

ACTIVITIES:
- ⟦{総会|そうかい}→総会：13855_soukai⟧ - general meeting
- ⟦{運動会|うんどうかい}→運動会：03013_undoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手伝|てつだ}い→手伝い：02488_tetsudai⟧ - helping at sports day
- ⟦{登校|とうこう}→登校：16560_toukou⟧⟦{見守|みまも}り→見守る：04574_mimamoru⟧ - watching children go to school
- ⟦{広報|こうほう}{活動|かつどう}→広報活動：23840_kouhoukatsudou⟧ - public relations activities
- バザー - bazaar/flea market

CULTURAL NOTE:
PTA membership in Japan is often considered obligatory, and many parents feel pressure to participate. The volunteer work can be time-consuming, leading to discussions about PTA reform.
